title: Native Local Annotate
script: Welcome to this deep dive into Native Local Annotate. Part of PaperPilot's native Document Operations suite, this tool provides deterministic, local-first execution. Engineered entirely in pure Rust, it operates with zero cloud egress, giving you complete data privacy, no SaaS subscription fees, and no external API rate limits. Now let us examine the input parameters and what each signifies. You configure input, an required parameter for Path to the input PDF file.. In addition, annotations, an optional parameter for List of explicit annotation objects ({id, type, page, x, y, w, h, color, content}) or JSON string/file path.. In addition, rules, an optional parameter for List of pattern/rule annotation objects ({type, color, search, regex, occurrence, content}).. In addition, search, an optional parameter for Shorthand literal keyword to find and annotate.. In addition, regex, an optional parameter for Shorthand regular expression pattern to find and annotate.. In addition, type, an optional parameter for Annotation type used with search/regex shorthand (default 'highlight').. In addition, color, an optional parameter for Hex color used with search/regex shorthand (default '#FFFF00').. In addition, occurrence, an optional parameter for Occurrence filter for shorthand rules (default 'all').. In addition, case_sensitive, an optional parameter for Enable case-sensitive search/regex shorthand matching (default false).. In addition, content, an optional parameter for Optional comment or popup text attached to shorthand annotations.. Every parameter is rigorously validated in memory before processing begins, ensuring safe, predictable transformations across all your documents. Next, output files and metrics. The tool emits optimized .pdf documents at Destination path for the annotated .pdf file.. By pruning redundant objects, deduplicating font streams, and applying memory-safe Rayon parallelism, it slashes document file size by up to eighty percent in under fifteen milliseconds, with zero bytes leaked to the cloud. You can deploy pdf_annotate across all five universal interfaces. First, drag and drop in the desktop dock for live inspection. Second, call it autonomously from Claude or AI agents through our native Model Context Protocol server. Third, run it directly in your terminal with the PaperPilot CLI. Fourth, trigger it via local REST API POST requests at localhost port 8080. And fifth, execute it client-side in your browser with zero-upload WebAssembly. Unlock total document privacy and native performance today. Visit usepaperpilot.com to explore pdf_annotate and all one hundred tools, run live interactive benchmarks, and download the bare-metal binary. Local-first document intelligence, powered by PaperPilot.
